reasoning: The site plan shows buildings positioned near the southern property boundary adjacent to the SF-3 zoned parcel. Under Article 10 (LDC § 25-2-1051), compatibility standards apply when a site is zoned MF-4 or less restrictive (MF-2 qualifies) AND located within 75 feet of a triggering property (1-3 dwelling units + SF-5 or more restrictive zoning). SF-3 is a qualifying triggering property zone. The vision analysis showed buildings at 25-28.8 feet from the property line. This measurement will confirm whether Article 10 is triggered and whether the site needs a compatibility buffer and height restrictions per § 25-2-1061 and § 25-2-1062.

applicableChecklistItems.checklist_deficiency_text: Compatibility standards (Article 10) applicability incorrectly determined: Article 10 applies when a site is zoned MF-4 or less restrictive AND is located within 75 feet of a triggering property; a triggering property is a site with 1–3 dwelling units zoned SF-5 or more restrictive (LA, RR, SF-1, SF-2, SF-3, SF-4A, SF-4B, or SF-5)

Compatibility buffer not shown at the correct width along the shared triggering property line: the required buffer is 25 feet wide (standard) or 15 feet wide if the development site is less than 75 feet wide measured from the shared triggering property line

Compatibility cross-sections not provided or incomplete: cross-sections must show the triggering property boundary, distance measurements from the triggering property boundary to proposed structures at the 50-ft and 75-ft thresholds, proposed building heights at each distance band, and elevation of the triggering property grade
